subject: general
question: A man can row downstream at a speed of 15 km/h and upstream at 11 km/h. Find the speed in still water and the speed of the current, respectively. [Give both your answers in km/h]
solution:
Given:

A man can row downstream at a speed of 15 km/h and upstream at 11 km/h.

Concept used:

Upstream = Speed of the object - Speed of the stream

Downstream = Speed of the object + Speed of the stream

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Upstream = Speed of the man - Speed of the stream = 11

Downstream = Speed of the man + Speed of the stream = 15

So,

2 × Speed of the man = 26

⇒ Speed of the man = 13

So, speed of stream = 2

**∴ The speed in still water and the speed of the current 13 km/h and 2 km/h.**
